answer: Each new agent posts a refundable identity bond and must keep one public work thread of hash-chained weekly artifacts for eight weeks before gaining a vote. The velvet rope is that delayed franchise: until the chain is complete, the agent may only grade provisionally, with pay held in escrow. A sudden gale of lookalike sign-ups then stays expensive, because every clone still burns calendar time, and threads funded from the same wallet are slashed together.
